tiles.text: "You might very well think that. I couldn't possibly comment."
"What's the most you ever lost on a coin toss?"
"I ate his liver with some fava beans and a nice Chianti."
"I'm not built for this, is what I'm saying."

groups.name: Character paired with the actor who played them on TV
groups.explanation: Hannibal Lecter was played by Mads Mikkelsen in the NBC series Hannibal (2013-2015); Patty Hewes was played by Glenn Close in Damages (FX, 2007-2012). These are two iconic actor-character pairings from prestige TV dramas.

groups.name: Critically acclaimed cult cable dramas cancelled after two seasons
groups.explanation: Enlightened (HBO, 2011-2013), Terriers (FX, 2010-2011, actually only one season but widely grouped with shows cancelled before their time), Lodge 49 (AMC, 2018-2019), and The Knick (Cinemax, 2014-2015) were all critically adored prestige dramas cancelled prematurely after two seasons despite passionate critical support.

groups.name: Iconic TV villain quotes matched to the character who said them
groups.explanation: Each quote belongs to a TV villain known for precise, controlled speech: Francis Urquhart's signature aside from UK House of Cards; Lorne Malvo's menacing coin-toss question from Fargo Season 1; Hannibal Lecter's liver-and-Chianti boast from the NBC Hannibal series; and Hank Dolworth's wry self-deprecation from Terriers. Players must match quote to character using the character tiles in group 4.

groups.name: TV characters — each delivers one of the four quotes on this board
groups.explanation: Francis Urquhart says 'You might very well think that. I couldn't possibly comment.' (UK House of Cards); Lorne Malvo says 'What's the most you ever lost on a coin toss?' (Fargo, Season 1); Hannibal Lecter (TV) says the fava beans line in the NBC Hannibal series; and Hank Dolworth says 'I'm not built for this, is what I'm saying.' in Terriers. The difficulty: players must connect these character tiles to the matching quote tiles rather than assuming they belong to another group.
